POST /api/users

{"username": "demo", "email": "d@x.y", "is_admin": true}
findings.remediation:
Mass assignment: the API binds unvalidated client-supplied fields to internal models.
Fix:
  1. Use explicit field allowlists (DTOs / strong parameters) for every bindable model.
  2. Reject unknown fields instead of silently ignoring them.
  3. Never bind security-sensitive fields (role/is_admin/scope) from user input.
  4. Test: send requests with added authorization fields and assert they are ignored.
